text: Pretend visit. Sacral pressure injury, unstageable. Wound bed is about sixty percent black eschar with yellow slough at the margins and a little granulation. Edges are attached, periwound intact with mild erythema. Moderate serosanguineous drainage. Cleansed with Prontosan, applied Aquacel Ag with a Mepilex Border over top. Braden score fourteen. Offloading discussed.

Right plantar diabetic foot ulcer, neuropathic. Rolled edges with epibole, hyperkeratotic callus around the periwound. Wound bed has friable granulation with some desiccated slough. No undermining or tunnelling. Probe to bone negative. Dressed with Hydrofera Blue and a Coban 2 wrap. ABPI ordered. Charcot changes noted on the left.

Left lower leg venous ulcer with lipodermatosclerosis and hemosiderin staining. Mild pitting edema. Heavy serous drainage soaking through. Applied Kaltostat, then Profore compression. Unna boot considered for next week. Bates-Jensen tool completed. Periwound macerated, protect with barrier film.

Surgical wound dehiscence on the abdomen, sinus tract present at the lower edge. Purulent drainage and increased warmth, concern for osteomyelitis ruled out for now. NERDS criteria met. Applied Iodosorb and Allevyn Life. NPWT with a PICO dressing planned. Wound bed epithelialization at the upper margin.

Heel pressure injury, stage three. Cutimed Sorbact and Silvercel used, Acticoat on the second wound. Medihoney applied to the slough. Hypergranulation at one edge treated with silver nitrate. Biatain on the dry area. Autolytic debridement continuing. PUSH tool score recorded. PHMB gel and cadexomer iodine in the supply bag.

Moisture associated skin damage, MASD, with periwound erythema. Mepitel as contact layer, PolyMem on top. Inadine used earlier but stopped. Kaltostat for bleeding. STONEES review done, no signs of infection. Unstageable area on the coccyx is resolving. Allevyn dressings changed, Tegaderm on the intact skin.
